_about: What atv.py knows about preinstalled Android TV packages. Only packages listed here
(plus unknown ones whose names look like ads or telemetry, which are always asked about
one by one) are ever offered for disabling. Everything is disabled with
'pm disable-user', never uninstalled, and the restore script turns it back on.
ads        promoted content and ad services. Offered as a group.
telemetry  usage, crash and viewing reports sent to the maker. Offered as a group.
junk       does nothing useful on a TV. Offered as a group.
optional   things you might use: always asked one by one, default No.
launcher   the stock home screen: only handled by 'install-home', after Glass Home
is installed and shown to work.
keep       never touched, even if a plan asks.

packages.label: Android TV recommendations
packages.why: Feeds promoted rows to the old Android TV home screen.

packages.label: Android ad services (Privacy Sandbox)
packages.why: Ad-topic and ad-measurement APIs for advertisers. Nothing on a TV needs it to work.

packages.label: Google feedback
packages.why: Sends crash and feedback reports to Google.

packages.label: Samba TV
packages.why: Automatic content recognition: identifies what is on screen, inputs included, for ads.

packages.label: NVIDIA feedback
packages.why: Feedback and log uploads to NVIDIA.

packages.label: Amazon crash manager
packages.why: Crash and log uploads to Amazon.

packages.label: Print spooler
packages.why: Printing. A TV has nothing to print.

packages.label: Default print service
packages.why: Printing. A TV has nothing to print.

packages.label: Print service recommendations
packages.why: Printing. A TV has nothing to print.

packages.label: Android TV Core Services (recommendations)
packages.why: Builds the stock home screen's 'play next' and channel rows. Glass Home doesn't use it; the stock home screen loses its rows without it.

packages.label: Ambient mode (Google TV screensaver)
packages.why: The Google TV screensaver: photos plus suggested shows. Without it the TV falls back to a plain screensaver.

packages.label: Google app for Android TV
packages.why: Voice search and the Google Assistant. Disable only if you never use the remote's microphone button.

packages.label: Chromecast built-in
packages.why: Casting from phones and laptops. Disable only if you never cast.

packages.label: Google TV (Play Movies & TV)
packages.why: Google's store for renting and buying films.

packages.label: Google TV home screen
packages.why: The stock home screen with its suggestion rows and banner.

packages.label: Fire TV home screen
packages.why: Fire OS ignores other home screens and may refuse this; atv.py checks and rolls back.
